children: Nauticus Robotics signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Ocean Power Technologies’ WAM-V business assets for $8 million in preferred stock.
The proposed deal includes WAM-V unmanned surface vessel assets, software and intellectual property.
Up to $2 million in additional consideration would depend on specified equity financing proceeds and future WAM-V-related revenues.
The acquisition would expand Nauticus Robotics’ portfolio into surface operations and could support integration with its Aquanaut subsea platform.
The LOI is non-binding; closing depends on due diligence, definitive agreements, approvals, required consents and other conditions.
The parties intend to work toward completing the acquisition within 45 days of OPT’s acceptance, but completion is not assured.
